qiblaTooClose: I ka surun Kaaba la kojugu, o la kibila fan min ka tiɲɛ bɛ se ka jira.
qiblaPathInfoTitle: Kibila sira bɛ jate cogo di?
qiblaPathExplanation: Nɔ in bɛ sira surunnen jira ka bɔ yɔrɔ min i sugandilen na ka taa Kaaba la, ka WGS84 dugukolo jateminɛ cogo jɛ. Kariti dalen kan, sira bɛ se ka kɔrɔn, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la ni yɔrɔw ka jan. Ni a ka surun, a bɛ se ka kɛ ni a telen don. Kibila flɛ bɛ fan min na i ka kan ka taa, o jira i ka yɔrɔ la.

privacyPage.intro: Qibla bɛ i dɛmɛ ka kibila fan lɔn ka bɔ yɔrɔ min i sugandilen na. Gundola kunnafoni nin bɛ web yɔrɔ ni Android aplikasiyɔn na. Qibla tɛ i mako jɛfɛrɛ kontu la.
privacyPage.locationText: Ni i ye yɔrɔ ɲinini daminɛ, Qibla bɛ yamaruya ɲini i ka navigatɛri walima Android fɛ. Latitude, longitude ani jateminɛ tiɲɛya bɛ kɛ i ka minɛn kɔnɔ walasa kibila fan jate ani kariti jira. GPS yɔrɔw minw sɔrɔlen don ka tɔ i yɛrɛ ye, olu tɛ ci Geoapify ma i ka ɲinini kunnafoni kɔnɔ. Yɔrɔ ɲinini tɛ wajibi ye. I bɛ se ka yɔrɔ sugandi i yɛrɛ ye.
privacyPage.storageTitle: 2. Kunnafoni mara i ka minɛn kɔnɔ
privacyPage.storageText: Yɔrɔ kunnafoni minw sɔrɔlen don a yɛrɛma, ani a jateminɛ tiɲɛya, olu bɛ mara sessionStorage kɔnɔ. Yɔrɔ minw i sugandilen don, kan, ja cogo ani fɔlɔ daminɛli hali bɛ mara localStorage kɔnɔ. Android aplikasiyɔn kɔnɔ, o mara baaraw bɛ kɛ WebView kɔnɔ. I ka minɛn kɔnɔ mara kelen tɛ kunnafoni ci Qibla ka server ma.
privacyPage.searchTitle: 3. Yɔrɔ ɲinini Cloudflare ni Geoapify fɛ
privacyPage.searchText: Ni i bɛ yɔrɔ walima adɛrɛsi ɲini, i ka ɲinini sɛbɛn bɛ ci Geoapify ma ka tɛmɛ Cloudflare bɛrɛ fɛ. Cloudflare Worker bɛ IP adɛrɛsi min Cloudflare bɛ di, o baara kɛ walasa ɲinini hakɛ ka dɔgɔya. Don kelen ɲinini hakɛ jateminɛli tɛ mɔgɔ kelen kelen ka ɲinini dosiyɛri mara. Geoapify bɛ ɲinini sɛbɛn ni API laajili kunnafoni teknikiw baara kɛ. Baarakɛminɛn tigi ka kunnafoni kɔsɔn, laajili minw bɛ kɛ koɲuman, olu kunnafoni kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw tɛ mara ka tɛmɛ lɛri 24 kan ka ca. Ni lakana walima baarakɛcogo jugu ko kɛra, laajili kunnafoni dɔw bɛ se ka mara fo kalo fila.
privacyPage.tilesText: Ni i ye kariti dabɔ, kariti fɛnw bɛ ɲini tile.openstreetmap.org la a yɛrɛ fɛ. O de kosɔn, i ka IP adɛrɛsi ni laajili kunnafoni teknikiw bɛ ci OpenStreetMap Foundation walima a ka kariti minɛnw ma. Kariti yɔrɔ minw ɲininen don, olu bɛ se ka yɔrɔ min i bɛ a lajɛ, o jira. Jɛman ni finman cogo fila bɛ baara kɛ ni baarakɛyɔrɔ kelen ye. OpenStreetMap Foundation bɛ kunnafoni wɛrɛw di kunnafoni baara kɛcogo ni marali kan a ka gundola sariya kɔnɔ.
privacyPage.hostingText: Qibla web yɔrɔ ni ɲinini bɛrɛ bɛ baarakɛ Cloudflare fɛ. IP adɛrɛsiw, URL minw ɲininen don, tuma ni kunnafoni teknikiw bɛ se ka baara kɛ walasa baarakɛli, lakana ani fili ɲinini ka kɛ. Cloudflare bɛ fɔ ko Workers Logs minw daminɛlen don, olu marali tuma bɛ kɛ don saba walima don wolonwula, ni kontu plan ye min ye. Lakana ni jateminɛ kunnafoni wɛrɛw bɛ se ka mara tuma jan. Min bɛ kɛ tigitigi la, o bɛ Cloudflare baarakɛminɛnw minw daminɛlen don ni kontu sɛgɛsɛgɛliw de la.
privacyPage.operatorText: Mɔgɔ min bɛ Qibla kunnafoni mara, a ni mɔgɔ min i bɛ se ka kuma a fɛ gundola ko la:
privacyPage.paypalText: Qibla bɛ PayPal lɛnki ni QR kɔdi min maralen don i ka minɛn kɔnɔ, o jira walasa dɛmɛ min bɔra i yɛrɛ la. QR kɔdi jira kelen tɛ PayPal ni i cɛ ka ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ. Ni i ye lɛnki dabɔ walima i taara PayPal la QR kɔdi fɛ, PayPal bɛ se ka i ka yɛrɛkunnafoni ni wari sarali kunnafoni baara kɛ. PayPal ka gundola sariya bɛ baara kɛ a ka kunnafoni baara kɛli kan.
privacyPage.retentionTitle: 8. Kunnafoni marali tuma ni a bɔli
privacyPage.retentionText: Yɔrɔ min sɔrɔlen don a yɛrɛma bɛ mara sessionStorage kɔnɔ tuma min na i bɛ baara kɛ. Yɔrɔ minw i sugandilen don, kan, ja cogo ani fɔlɔ daminɛli hali bɛ tɔ localStorage kɔnɔ fo ka yɛlɛma walima ka bɔ. I bɛ se ka web kunnafoniw bɔ i ka navigatɛri kɔnɔ walima Android aplikasiyɔn kunnafoniw bɔ a ka sɛgɛsɛgɛliw kɔnɔ. Kamera ni yɔrɔ yamaruyaw bɛ se ka yɛlɛma walima ka bɔ i ka minɛn ni navigatɛri sɛgɛsɛgɛliw kɔnɔ. Baarakɛminɛn wɛrɛw ka marali tuma bɛ olu ka baarakɛ sababu ni gundola sariyaw de la.
privacyPage.rightsText: Qibla tɛ baarakɛla kontu sigi, ani a tɛ GPS yɔrɔ dosiyɛriw mara a yɛrɛ ka server kan. Ni mɔgɔ ka yɛrɛkunnafoni bɛ baara kɛ, GDPR sariya bɛ hakɛw di i ma, i n'a fɔ kunnafoni lɔn, ka a latilen, ka a bɔ, ka a kɛcogo damina ani ka a banna. Kunnafoni ta ka taa yɔrɔ wɛrɛ fana bɛ se ka kɛ i ka hakɛ ye. I bɛ se ka i ka laajili di kunnafoni lakana kɔmiti ma. Gundola ɲininkaliw kosɔn, email adɛrɛsi min sɛbɛnnen don sanfɛ, o baara kɛ.
privacyPage.cameraSensorsText: Qibla bɛ kamera yamaruya ɲini walasa AR kamera baarakɛli ka kɛ. Kamera ka ja min bɛ jira sisan, o bɛ baara kɛ i ka minɛn kɔnɔ. Ni kibila fan sɔrɔla, kamera ja bɛ se ka lɔ dɔɔnin. Kamera ja si tɛ mara tuma bɛɛ ni a tɛ ci server wɛrɛ ma. Kamera ni kɔmpasi bɛ minɛn ka fan ni a ka biri sensɔriw kunnafoni baara kɛ i ka minɛn kɔnɔ. Fan sɔrɔli bɛ se ka minɛn ɲɛnamaya. Aplikasiyɔn ka ja masani ni Ramadan ja yɛlɛmali fana bɛ kɛ i ka minɛn kɔnɔ ni kalandiriye jateminɛ ye.
privacyPage.legalBasisTitle: 11. Sariya sababu ni kunnafoni cilenw jamana wɛrɛw ma
privacyPage.legalBasisText: Baarakɛminɛn di, lakana ani baarakɛli min jɛfɛrɛla ɲininen don, olu bɛ se ka kɛ GDPR article 6(1)(f) kan. Sariya fɛ kunnafoni ka baara kɛ sababu ye ka Qibla baarakɛli lakana ani a ka baara kɛ koɲuman. Kunnafoni ɲini walima mara i ka minɛn kɔnɔ, o fana bɛ Almaniya ka TDDDG article 25 sariya kɔrɔ, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la baara min wajibi don walasa ka baarakɛli di mɔgɔ min ye a ɲini. Cloudflare bɛ se ka kunnafoni baara kɛ Eropi ekonomi kɛrɛw kɔfɛ. Baarakɛli cogo kɔsɔn, lakana jɔyɔrɔw i n'a fɔ yamaruya kararw ni EU Standard Contractual Clauses bɛ se ka kɛ. Qibla tɛ mɔgɔ ɲɛsinna ka sariya ko walima ko kunbɛn ka dɔgɔya ni a yɛrɛma jateminɛli ye, ani a tɛ mɔgɔ ka reklam profilw sigi.

imprintPage.donationText: Wari minw sɔrɔlen don, olu bɛna di makotigɛlaw ma. Aplikasiyɔn dilanna tɛ o wari si ta a yɛrɛ ye.

qiblaFaqPage.intro: Kibila ni Kaaba ko ɲininkaliw ni u jaabiw.
qiblaFaqPage.meaningAnswer: Kibila ye fan ye min na silamɛw bɛ u ɲɛsin ni u bɛ seli. O ye Kaaba fan ye Makka la.
qiblaFaqPage.unityQuestion: Mun na silamɛw bɛ u ɲɛsin fan kelen na ni u bɛ seli?
qiblaFaqPage.unityAnswer: Seli fan kelen bɛ silamɛw fara ɲɔgɔn na diɲɛ bɛɛ la. Kuran bɛ a fɔ ko u ka u ɲɛsin Masjid al-Haram ma Makka la (2:144).
qiblaFaqPage.worshipQuestion: Silamɛw bɛ Kaaba de bato wa?
qiblaFaqPage.worshipAnswer: Ayi. Silamɛw bɛ Allah de bato, u tɛ Kaaba bato. Kaaba ye yɔrɔ ye min na u bɛ u ɲɛsin ni u bɛ seli.
qiblaFaqPage.builderQuestion: Jɔn ye Kaaba jɔ ani tuma jumen?
qiblaFaqPage.builderAnswer: Kuran ko la, Ibrahim ni a den Ismail ye Kaaba jɔli senkolo jɔ (2:127). A jɔli san tigitigi ma lɔn.
qiblaFaqPage.locationAnswer: Kaaba bɛ Masjid al-Haram kɔnɔ, Makka, Saudi Arabia la.
qiblaFaqPage.calculationQuestion: Qibla bɛ seli fan jate cogo di?
qiblaFaqPage.calculationAnswer: Qibla bɛ fan jate ka bɔ yɔrɔ sugandilen na ka taa Kaaba la, ni WGS84 dugukolo jateminɛ ye. Flɛ bɛ seli fan jira i ka yɔrɔ la.
